name: gestures
title: Mouse gestures
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Right-click menus, middle-click tab closing and tab dragging.
description: Contributes mouse bindings for pane and tab menus, plus middle-click to close a tab and dragging a tab onto another to move it there. It uses the normal pane and tab commands rather than owning programs. Turn it off to remove these gestures; keyboard commands and the vqro recovery badge remain.

works_with.without: Dragging a tab does not move it

keys: Drag a tab onto another: move it there
